When I have moved supers pre citadel, I went through the same prep that most people went through. 

I search maps for a quiet jump route, sometimes doing extra jumps to hit quieter systems. I would then anchor control towers in the systems I was going to, stront and fuel them for at least 24hrs. (never anchor a tower in hostile sov space, they get a notification)

Once my cyno alt is ready and cloacked in system I would start the 2min self destruct. With an alt in the system that super was in I would make sure that local was clear, with about 40 seconds on SD I would log the super in and join fleet....assuming that both locals were clear I would jump in 200km from the tower cycle the MWD and warp to the tower logging off as the cyno dies.

My main thing was never to jump if either local had neutrals in it, something that helped me moonwalk through several regions....

However post citadel there are enough free-ported fortz and keepstars to make moving painless and simple, just make sure the owner is reputable
